item.title: Midway snowboarder who chose amputation to keep competing qualifies for 2026 Paralympics
item.description: A snowboarder from Midway will be performing in the 2026 Paralympic Winter Games.

item.title: Woman crashes into restaurant in Sandy
item.description: A woman crashed into the front entrance of a Mexican restaurant on Wednesday.

item.title: Robert Cosby Jr., son of ‘Real Housewives of Salt Lake City’ star, dies at 23
item.description: Robert Cosby Jr., son of “Real Housewives of Salt Lake City” star Mary Cosby, has died at 23, according to police.

item.title: No more waiting at red lights, snowplows in northern Utah can drive on through
item.description: Snowplows in northern Utah won't have to wait at red lights anymore after new technology allows the plows to get green lights every time.

item.title: At least $20,000 worth of instruments stolen from touring band in Salt Lake City
item.description: The Göners ÜK were on their way back from a tour in Southern California to Bozeman when they say a window of their van was smashed in Salt Lake City

item.title: Cuba says it killed 4 people aboard Florida-registered speedboat that opened fire on soldiers in local waters
item.description: Cuban soldiers have killed four people aboard a speed boat registered in Florida that opened fire on officers in Cuban waters.

item.title: Vance says administration is pausing some Medicaid funding to Minnesota because of fraud concerns
item.description: Vice President JD Vance says the Trump administration will “temporarily halt” some Medicaid funding to the state of Minnesota over fraud concerns.

item.title: Bomb threat at Salt Lake Community College sends police searching campus
item.description: A bomb threat was called into the Salt Lake Community College campus, prompting police to sweep the area.

item.title: AI voice cloning used to convince Lehi parent their child was kidnapped
item.description: Police are warning about AI voice cloning after scammers called a Lehi parent recently and used their child's screaming voice to convince them of a kidnapping.
